in_marathi.name: Mandeep
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mandeep हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘manda’ (moon) and ‘deep’ (deep). This name symbolizes a person who is deeply connected to the divine moon.

in_bengali.name: Mandeep
in_bengali.long_meaning: Mandeep একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘manda’ (moon) and ‘deep’ (deep). This name symbolizes a person who is deeply connected to the divine moon.
